exam_submission_teacher.name: exam_submission_teacher
exam_submission_teacher.value: ("exam_submission"."teacher_points" IS NULL AND "exam_submission"."teacher_max" IS NULL) OR ("exam_submission"."teacher_max" > 0 AND "exam_submission"."teacher_points" BETWEEN 0 AND "exam_submission"."teacher_max")

profile_custodian_cible.name: profile_custodian_cible
profile_custodian_cible.value: ("profile_custodian"."nature" = 'ecole' AND "profile_custodian"."school_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("profile_custodian"."nature" <> 'ecole' AND ("profile_custodian"."account_id" IS NOT NULL OR "profile_custodian"."status" = 'invite' OR "profile_custodian"."status" = 'termine'))

quran_reciter_retrait.name: quran_reciter_retrait
quran_reciter_retrait.value: "quran_reciter"."status" <> 'retire' OR ("quran_reciter"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL AND length("quran_reciter"."retired_reason") > 0)
